title: Integral adic general constructibility implies finite constant local models
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell equipped with a compatible embedding into the fixed algebraic closure, and its canonical condensed valuation ring Lambda = Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E. For every noetherian scheme X, general stratified locally finitely presented Lambda_X-modules have finite constant scalar local models on a finite constructible stratification. This is only the integral coefficient-heart comparison, independent of any morphism or adjunction.

proof.text: Use NormedAlgebra.norm_eq_spectralNorm to identify the norm induced by the embedding E -> PadicAlgCl with Padic.coefficientExtensionAbsoluteValue. The normalization module supplies the ring equivalence from the WithAbs universe lift and the spectral absolute value under ULift. Restrict it to elements of absolute value at most one, obtaining an isometric ring equivalence from latticeCoefficientIntegers ell (ULift E) to PadicAlgCl.integers ell E. Postcomposition gives a natural isomorphism of the continuous-map condensed ring sheaves, preserving their specified multiplication.

Transport general constructibility by restriction of scalars along the pulled-back coefficient isomorphism. Apply integralLfpConstantModelComparison at ULift E to obtain finite constant models. Transport those models back: restriction along a coefficient isomorphism preserves regular modules, finite biproducts and cokernels, so preserves the finite presentations on the point. mapModComapIso and comapUpperStarIso give the required compatibility on strata and covering members. The same covers and stratifications work; the equivalence counit identifies the doubly transported module with M. All transport helpers are proved in this module, with no additional obligation.

theorem ellAdic_integral_constructible_constantModel
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : Type) [Field E] [Algebra E (PadicAlgCl ℓ)] [Algebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    [IsScalarTower ℚ_[ℓ] E (PadicAlgCl ℓ)] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X) M →
      IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X M
